stateOwner: one headless coordinator owns A/V generation, replacement, tick, cancellation, terminal, and close state

invariants.generation: the coordinator assigns one exact positive generation to an independently prepared video candidate and the audio session
invariants.replacement: video open and one bounded prefill complete before exact-generation audio commit; any earlier refusal preserves the active A/V generation
invariants.commit: successful audio commit is followed only by a no-fail video candidate pointer swap
invariants.postCommitTerminal: an audio failure after exact-generation commit advances the coordinator to that generation, terminates its video candidate, and permits the next exact generation
invariants.interruption: cancel and close request the active operation stop handle before waiting for the state lock; exact-generation audio preparation receives that same stop token
invariants.clock: one cached generation-matched audio position is read per tick and passed unchanged to the presentation selector
invariants.tick: selection and at most the configured bounded fill calls continue until an early frame, video EOF, no progress, or budget exhaustion
invariants.delivery: one tick returns only its latest selected frame and counts every older selected or superseded due frame as dropped
invariants.terminal: video EOF does not end audio; audio completion, cancellation, invalidation, or failure terminates the A/V generation without extrapolating a clock
invariants.close: close publishes an admission gate before interrupting and waiting for admitted work, rejects late operations and commits, cancels active video state, closes audio exactly once, and returns one stable receipt

excluded: final hardware endpoint position at audio completion
seek, scrub, speed change, and drift correction
